title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: Six public PhilGEPS category first pages were checked without login. The official UNGM public notice page was checked, but its public search endpoint returned HTTP 400; two active official direct notices were verified.

best_opportunities.project: Procurement of one (1) lot – Influencer Marketing Service
best_opportunities.method: Negotiated Procurement – Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ
best_opportunities.fit: Direct Brandee fit: influencer plan, recommended influencer list, content deployment calendar, monthly campaign performance reports, and social-media analytics.
best_opportunities.requirements: Current PhilGEPS registration certificate/number, Mayor’s or Business Permit, notarized NGPA Omnibus Sworn Statement, income/business-tax return, and corporate authority documents; signed quotation; 30-working-day price validity. Personal/sealed submission at PHLPost Annex II, Manila is stated.
best_opportunities.risks: Only three days remain; the TOR is not public without the associated component path. AIStaff must substantiate an influencer roster, campaign delivery capability, and on-site Manila submission. The notice says a three-month delivery period but text says complete by 31 December 2026.
best_opportunities.next: Obtain/review the TOR immediately; confirm submission logistics and evaluation criteria; prepare a defensible influencer shortlist, calendar, sample content workflow, analytics/reporting template, and all 2026 eligibility documents.

best_opportunities.project: Open Journal System web-hosting package with DOI integration, themes, and website domain
best_opportunities.method: Negotiated Procurement – Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34); RFQ
best_opportunities.fit: A contained custom web/hosting and integration assignment compatible with AIStaff’s website, dashboard, support, and integration capability.
best_opportunities.requirements: Sealed signed quotation at RTU BAC Secretariat, Mandaluyong, with a photocopy of the PhilGEPS Registration Certificate. The attached RFQ is controlling.
best_opportunities.risks: Small value and a specialized academic publishing stack; full scope, SLA, DOI provider, migration, support, and acceptance terms are in an attachment not publicly accessible without login.
best_opportunities.next: Request the public RFQ through the contact person, validate OJS/DOI capability and support expectations, and pursue only if scope can be delivered profitably and without unsupported specialist claims.

best_opportunities.method: Request for Expression of Interest; UNGM Basic registration
best_opportunities.fit: The specified UNSPSC includes contact-center and reference software, and AIStaff’s custom AI/workflow capability overlaps the technical theme.
best_opportunities.requirements: WFP seeks suppliers with verified technical and financial capacity; submit the EOI response form and requested documents by email. UNGM Basic registration is shown.
best_opportunities.risks: Closes today; the legal-AI domain needs credible governance, legal-content, security, and capacity evidence. Do not imply a mature legal-AI product unless it is demonstrable.
best_opportunities.next: Only submit if AIStaff already has a truthful legal-AI capability package, completed EOI form, capacity evidence, and approval-ready submission materials before deadline.

not_recommended.project: Emergency Response and Public Safety Command Center Upgrade
not_recommended.reason: Potential systems integration appears hardware/command-center heavy and is a public bid with inconsistent dates: the header closes 6 November while the description says bid opening is 18 November. Full technical and eligibility documents are needed before any match assessment.

not_recommended.project: Groundwater Information System and Telemetry Systems (Phase 1)
not_recommended.reason: Although it mentions an information system, it is a PHP 18.96M groundwater/telemetry consultancy with specialist domain, field telemetry, and public-bidding demands beyond AIStaff’s demonstrated services.

not_recommended.project: UNHCR Web/App Development and Maintenance Services for MENA
not_recommended.reason: Directly relevant but expired on 22 October 2026; do not treat it as actionable.

todays_recommendation: Prioritize PHLPost Influencer Marketing Service (13302752), conditional on TOR review, credible influencer roster, and sealed-submission confirmation.
notes: No access controls were bypassed. UNGM public search returned HTTP 400; direct public notices were checked.
